node.statement: The assumed bijectivity of Pi_{delta_k} makes it injective on calU x B^{calH}_{delta_k}(J). Applying injectivity to the two domain points from the preceding step gives p_1=p_2, hence u_1(X)=u_2(X) and h_1(X)=h_2(X). Since X was arbitrary in S_1 intersect S_2, coherence holds there.
